content: Goday enta Xoossay kiitida qaala ubbaa Ermiyaasi entaw odidi wursidaape guye,
Hoshaya na7ay Azaariyasi, Qaraya na7ay Yohaaninne otorancho asa ubbay Ermiyaasako, “Ne wordo odaasa! Goday nu Xoossay nu Gibxe bidi uttonna mela digganaw nena nuuko kiittibeenna.
Shin Babiloone asay nuna wodhanaada woyko di77idi banta biitta efanaada ne nuna enta kushen aathada immana mela nena nu bolla denthiday Neera na7aa Baaroka” yaagidosona.
Qaraya na7ay Yohaani, toora moconati ubbaynne asa ubbay Yihuda biittan daana mela Goday enta kiitida kiitta polonna ixidosona.
Qaraya na7ay Yohaaninne toora moconati ubbay banta laaletida kawotethata ubbaafe Yihudan daanaw simmida Yihuda asa bantara ekidi Gibxe bidosona.

Kawa naageysata halaqay Nabuzardaani Safaana na7aa, Akqaama na7aa Godoliyara daana mela ashshida addeta, maccasa, naytanne kawa macca nayta ubbaa efidosona. Qassi nabiya Ermiyaasanne Neera na7aa Baaroka efidosona.
Enti Godaa kiitaa ixidi, Gibxe biitta gelidi, Xafinaasa katamaa gakanaw bidosona.
Xafinaasan Godaa qaalay Ermiyaasako haysada yaagidi yis.
“Gita shuchata ekada, Yihuda asay be7ishin, Xafinaasan de7iya Gibxe kawa gadho geliya bessan sintha baggara de7iya baasuwan mooga.

Entako, ‘Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday, Isra7eele Xoossay haysada yaagees; ta kiittada, ta aylliya Babiloone kawa Nabukadanaxoora ehisana. Ha moogetida shuchata bolla iya kawotethaa araata wothana. I ba kawotetha dunkaaniya iya bolla essana.
I yidi Gibxe biitta olana. Hayqos besseysati hayqana; di7etanaw besseysati di7etana; mashshan hayqanaw besseysati mashshan hayqana.
Gibxen de7iya eeqa xoossata keethaa tama oythana; eeqata xuuggana woyko di77ana. Henthanchoy ba itiya ma7eysada, Gibxe biitta ma7ana. Yaatidi, yaape saro baana.
I, Gibxe biittan Heliyoota kataman de7iya hawultiya mentherethana; Gibxe xoossata keethaa taman xuuggana’ ” yaagis.
